newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded, only one bid posted, no offer.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded, only one bid posted, no offer.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were untraded on Monday morning, with only one bid posted by the close of the morning session.
A bid of 15.00 pence a therm was posted for February, against a previous settlement level of 17.515 pence.
A futures broker said there was no fundamental reason for the lack of activity, pointing out that many trading companies are involved in meetings on Mondays and trade is often slow to start.
